pr_title: Ensure that table printer always uses all available width in the terminal
pr_body:
Fixes an issue where, depending on the contents, table output such as from `* list` commands would too aggressively truncate text and not exactly fill all available width.

Bonus: URL columns are never truncated anymore. Fixes https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/1748

issue_context.title: never truncate URLs in tabular output
issue_context.body: ### Describe the bug A clear and concise description of what the bug is. Include version by typing `gh --version`. ### Steps to reproduce the behavior 1. Type this 'gh pr checks' 2. I see the output 3. The urls are incomplete ### Expected vs actual behavior I would expect to have the complete url so that I can click on it and see it in the browser, but it is incomplete.
comments:
thank you for opening this! it's a known issue but I don't think we'd captured it yet.

We need to adapt our table printer utility to never truncate URLs.

For now, you can try piping the output through `cat` to get around this, but then you will lose the pretty table formatting:

```
gh pr checks | cat
```

review_comments: Looks like the `medianColWidth` is no longer used, can we delete the related comments?

Good spot; I wanted to make use of median measurements to make weighted elastic resizing based on the contents of each column, but haven't gotten it right yet. Still, I would like to keep this around for now in case I have an epiphany later.
